Interview Process: Mandatory On-Site Interview

About the Opportunity

VTS3 Corp. is seeking a motivated and technically skilled Junior Full Stack Engineer (AI Agent Developer) to help build, test, and support enterprise conversational AI applications and modern web experiences.

This opportunity is ideal for an emerging software engineer with a solid foundation in Python, JavaScript or TypeScript, REST APIs, and front-end development, who is interested in building real-world artificial intelligence solutions.

Working alongside experienced engineers, you will contribute to conversational AI agents using Google Cloud Platform and Dialogflow CX, integrate applications with Microsoft Azure and ServiceNow, and develop user-friendly interfaces that connect people with intelligent systems.

You will also participate in automated testing, troubleshooting, CI/CD processes, and Agile development activities.

If you enjoy solving technical challenges, writing clean code, and turning ideas into functional applications, this position offers meaningful hands-on engineering experience.

What You'll Do
AI Agent Development & Backend Integration

Build, configure, and test conversational AI flows, intents, route groups, and LLM-powered tools using Dialogflow CX / GECX.

Contribute to AI agents developed using Google's Agent Development Kit (ADK).

Develop and maintain REST APIs, webhooks, and backend services primarily using Python.

Support integrations with Microsoft Azure, ServiceNow, and enterprise applications.

Write SQL queries supporting agent lookups, reporting, and conversational analytics.

Collaborate with senior engineers to troubleshoot integration and application issues.

Front-End Development

Develop responsive and accessible web interfaces using HTML, CSS, JavaScript or TypeScript, and modern frameworks such as React or Angular.

Connect front-end applications to backend services and conversational AI APIs.

Implement loading states, error handling, and browser session management.

Contribute to internal dashboards for AI agent analytics, test results, and administrative functions.

Testing, DevOps & Application Support

Write and execute unit tests, API tests, conversational flow regression tests, and front-end component tests.

Support Azure DevOps CI/CD pipelines and make reviewed updates to existing YAML configurations.

Investigate software defects, failed tests, and application issues.

Document technical findings and collaborate on issue resolution.

Maintain API documentation, conversational flow designs, UI component notes, and operational runbooks.

Collaboration & Agile Delivery

Participate in sprint planning, daily standups, backlog refinement, and Program Increment planning.

Work collaboratively with developers, product teams, and technical stakeholders.

Apply feedback from code reviews to improve software quality and development practices.

Contribute to continuous improvements in application performance, testing, and reliability.

This is an hourly position with opportunity for overtime.

 **All Candidates Must be Authorized to Legally Work in the US Without Sponsorship**
 

Mandatory Qualifications: (Please read carefully. They MUST be shown on your resume)
 

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Working proficiency in Python.

Working knowledge of .NET, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript or TypeScript.

Understanding of REST APIs, JSON, Model Context Protocol (MCP), webhooks, and browser-based API integration.

SQL query development skills.

Experience using Git and a modern development environment such as Visual Studio Code.

Exposure to unit testing frameworks such as PyTest, Jest, or xUnit.

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

Clear written and verbal communication skills.

Ability to collaborate with technical teams, accept feedback, and learn new technologies.

Preferred Qualifications

Hands-on exposure to Dialogflow CX, conversational AI, chatbots, or LLM-based applications. Academic projects and personal projects are welcome.

Familiarity with Google's Agent Development Kit (ADK) or similar agent frameworks.

Basic understanding of prompt engineering and intent classification.

Experience with React or Angular.

Familiarity with front-end testing tools such as Jest, Selenium, Playwright, or Cypress.

Exposure to Azure DevOps or other CI/CD platforms.

Familiarity with .NET/C#, ServiceNow REST APIs, or Flow Designer.

Basic understanding of OAuth2, API keys, secrets management, CORS, and XSS prevention.

Knowledge of Agile or SAFe development practices.

Familiarity with Docker, Kubernetes, or Terraform.

Exposure to Cloud Run, Azure Functions, or Contact Center AI (CCAI).

Interest in observability, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), and AIOps.

Technology Environment

AI & Cloud: Google Cloud Platform, Dialogflow CX / GECX, Google ADK, Microsoft Azure
Backend: Python 3.x, .NET/C#, Node.js, SQL
Frontend: HTML, CSS, JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Angular
Integrations: REST APIs, JSON, MCP, webhooks, ServiceNow
DevOps & Testing: Azure DevOps, Git, PyTest, Jest, xUnit, UI testing frameworks
Development Tools: Visual Studio Code, Antigravity
Agile: SAFe, Jira, Azure Boards

Why Consider This Opportunity?

Build real AI applications: Contribute to enterprise conversational AI solutions and the web interfaces supporting them.

Develop valuable technical skills: Gain practical experience across Python, full-stack engineering, cloud integrations, and automated testing.

Collaborate with experienced engineers: Work alongside senior developers and strengthen your software engineering capabilities.

Work across modern technologies: Apply your skills in Google Cloud, Microsoft Azure, ServiceNow, and modern web frameworks.

Contribute to meaningful projects: Help deliver AI-powered applications designed to support real enterprise operations.

About VTS3 Corp.

VTS3 Corp. is a Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned and Minority-Owned technology consulting, staffing, and business solutions firm.

We specialize in connecting talented professionals with opportunities across software development, artificial intelligence, cloud computing, cybersecurity, project management, and enterprise technology.

Our recruiting approach emphasizes technical excellence, professional development, accountability, and long-term relationships.

$500 Referral Fee Program

Earn extra cash while helping your friends!

VTS3 will pay you up to $500.00 for each person you refer to us and we place into a contract or full-time position. If you know someone who's a good candidate for any of our openings, use the "Refer a friend" button on this page and earn extra cash.

The rules are simple:

The referral must be made by using the "Refer a friend" button on this page
The person you refer must be placed within 90 days of being referred
The person you refer must complete 480 billable hours
Cannot be someone we already have on our team or are currently working with
